# Question 3

```{r}
# Can set d (dimensions) to be anything
d_sphere <- 2

x_matrix <- matrix(1:200, ncol=1)
for (i in 1:d_sphere){
  x_matrix <- cbind(x_matrix, rnorm(200, mean=0, sd=1))
}
x_matrix <- x_matrix[,-1]

norm_x_list<- list()
for (i in 1:d_sphere){
  norm_x_list[[i]] <- x_matrix[, i]/((t(x_matrix[, i])%*% x_matrix[, i])^(0.5))
}

u_vectors <- list()
for(i in 1:d_sphere){
  u_vectors[[i]] <- norm_x_list[[i]]/((sum(norm_x_list[[i]]^2))^(0.5))
}

two_dimensions <- data.frame(U1= norm_x_list[[1]], U2=norm_x_[[2]])

ggplot(two_dimensions, aes(x=U1, y=U2))+
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
d_sphere <- 2
x_matrix <- matrix(rnorm(400, mean=0, sd =1), ncol=2, nrow=200)
denominators <- sqrt(rowSums(x_matrix^2))
u_vectors <- x_matrix/denominators # x_matrix[i][j] / denominator[i] (don't need a for loop)

df <- data.frame(x = u_vectors[,1], y= u_vectors[,2])
ggplot(df, aes(x=x, y=y))+
  geom_point()
```
